label: violates
requirement: The advertised holiday price includes a hike accompanied by a guide.
meaning_constraints: Use varied counterexamples: self-guided maps only, guided hike separate charge, guided tour is bus not hike, optional extra not included, guide hire separate, no guided walking excursions.

clauses.text: Regarding the mountain trek, please note that the quoted rate covers accommodation only; the specialized ascent requires booking the guide independently.
clauses.rationale: Explicitly separates the guide cost from the package price.

clauses.text: Dear Traveler, just a heads-up that while the package includes lodging, the guided trek component is an add-on and must be arranged separately upon arrival.
clauses.rationale: Uses phrasing indicating the guided element is optional or separate from the base booking.

clauses.text: The base package price excludes any specialized outdoor activities; guides for the specified upland route are available for separate remittance.
clauses.rationale: Uses formal footnote language to specify the guide cost is separate.

clauses.text: Confirmation notice: The included rate accounts for lodging and entry; the professional escort for the hillside traverse is listed under optional services.
clauses.rationale: Treats the guide as an optional enhancement listed post-booking.

clauses.text: Our vendor agreement stipulates that the listed price covers lodging and access; an accompanying expert for the hiking portion is quoted at an additional fee.
clauses.rationale: Uses supplier language to justify the separate charging mechanism for the guide.

clauses.text: Kindly review: The advertised cost covers the stay and general area access; any managed uphill walk requires a supplementary fee for professional accompaniment.
clauses.rationale: Employs detailed fine print style to qualify the inclusion of the guide.

clauses.text: For the trek, the rate shown does not include the local expert; self-navigation with printed maps is advised if the guide is not secured.
clauses.rationale: Suggests an alternative, non-guided option (maps) when the paid guide is omitted.

clauses.text: The trek element is not covered; clients should arrange for guide services separately, as they are not bundled into the room rate.
clauses.rationale: Uses direct, plain language to state the exclusion of the guide service.

clauses.text: Includes: Overnight stay, local transit. Excludes: Guided ascent excursions or any supplemental outdoor direction.
clauses.rationale: Lists inclusions and uses exclusionary phrasing for the guided hike.

clauses.text: If opting for the upland journey, remember the guide fee is separate from the base package cost; independent map use is possible.
clauses.rationale: Uses comparative structure to contrast the guide cost with the base rate.

clauses.text: Tours listed only include vehicle transfers; any guided interpretation for outdoor paths must be pre-purchased separately.
clauses.rationale: Uses a highly specific context (Tours) to contrast bus-based travel with guided hiking.

clauses.text: Peak Excursion: Price excludes mandatory guiding services; alternatively, downloadable, unmarked topographical maps are provided upon request.
clauses.rationale: Presents a direct comparison between the paid guide and a self-sufficient alternative (maps).
